# FLUX 3 Image Klein edit

**Workflow:** [`flux3/flux3-klein-edit.json`](../flux3/flux3-klein-edit.json)

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Family | `flux3` |
| Nodes | 6 |
| Links | 4 |
| Paid API calls per run | **1** |

---

The fast, editing-first FLUX 3 model, with the three dials FLUX 3 Image does not have: `seed`, `steps` and `output_format`.

`seed` is **42**, **fixed**, so the same input and prompt give the same image. Set it to **-1** for a fresh random seed each run.

`steps` is **16**, the maximum and the default. Fewer is faster and rougher.

`resolution` is **default**, which leaves it out of the request: an edit then comes back at the input's own size, a text-to-image at 1k. There is no `match_input` on Klein because that is already what it does. Exact `width` / `height` start at 64 here rather than 256.

The API runs Klein's prompt upsampler for you, so a short instruction is fine; `expanded_prompt` shows the caption it wrote. Klein has no `grounding` or `version`.

Disconnect the image and the same node does text-to-image. Up to 10 references, as on FLUX 3 Image.

## The prompt lives in one node

The **Shared Prompt** node feeds the prompt in this graph, so there is one
place to edit it. It emits a plain string, **not** a list. That is the difference between it and **Prompt
List**, which would make each node it feeds run once per line and multiply what the graph
costs.
